disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: This is an early release of the CommonsDB Explorer, available for testing and feedback. Features are still under development and subject to change.

sidebar.coFundedByEu: CommonsDB is co-funded by the European Union under the 2023 work programme on the financing of Pilot Projects and Preparatory Actions in the field of Communications Networks, Content and Technology

description.part1: CommonsDB Explorer helps you discover declarations about Public Domain and openly licensed works. These declarations are provided by trusted repositories of cultural, scientific, and creative materials, including the Europeana Foundation and Wikimedia Commons. By bringing together rights information from these sources, CommonsDB makes it easier to confidently reuse, share, and build on openly available content.
description.part2: You can explore the registry by uploading a digital asset or searching with an ISCC code or Declaration ID. If matching declarations are stored in the registry, they will appear in your results. Uploaded files are processed only for ISCC generation and are never stored or retained.
